ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

8. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping home? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping home.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping home.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping home.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping home.

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Exploring weather? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Exploring weather.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Exploring weather.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Exploring weather.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Exploring weather.

13. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

15. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy resources.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Plants its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants its resources.

19. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

20. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmful effects of.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmful effects of.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Harmful effects of.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Energy resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Sounds that alert us and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Harmful effects of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

31. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise projects environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

32. In three clear sentences, explain Exploring and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
